headline: Oil's Hormuz-hope slide gave equities a Friday reprieve — but the data gauntlet ahead (PCE Wednesday, NFP Friday) will decide whether the October hike is locked in or debatable, and the RUT's persistent weakness is the tape's honest scorecard
Yields at multi-decade highs and an Oracle AI data-center shock keep the lean cautious into Friday, with Hormuz diplomacy and the Trump-Xi dinner as the overnight wildcards.

Yield shock dominates: a 19-year high in the 10-year rattled every corner of the market, with small caps hit hardest — Thursday's Trump-Xi summit and Friday's PCE are the two events most likely to decide whether this was a one-day flush or the start of a longer rate-repricing.
Tech holds the line on oil-diplomacy relief while financials and small-caps lag under a freshly hawkish Fed — Trump–Xi summit and Costco earnings are the week's live pivots.
Tech and chips surged as Iran diplomacy deflated oil, but small-caps lagged and the Trump-Xi summit on Thursday is the week's real binary — {LEAN_NDX} tilts positive, {LEAN_RUT} tilts cautious
